svg.title: FIG 02 · offline sync
svg.desc: Blueprint of how a reading leaves the phone: Submit saves it to Room (meter table plus an outbox row keyed by record_id), a WorkManager worker uploads the photos to S3, the record is validated on the phone against the payload contract, then it goes to the intake API, or to the failed API with the broken rule's error code. Network, server and key problems keep it on the phone for the next run; nothing is dropped.
svg.text: a reading is done only when the server confirms it · until then it waits on the phone
network · 5xx · bad key → kept on phone, retried
foreground: ≥ batch size or 2 h old · background: always
billing blocked at 20 pending · resend replaces its row, never a second copy
